# Atomic group A test audit

## Scope and result

- Worktree: `/workspace/terminal-mcp-atomic-a-kilo18-20261016`, checkpoint `df06249d91af79a651a4e113dfb3b65306b1e588`.
- Audited the full exact 45-file ownership manifest at `/workspace/tmcp-idle-kilo18-evidence-20261016/test-group-A.json`; no file outside it was edited.
- Manifest baseline: 646 collected cases. Current owned collection: 446, net -200 (31.0%). The requested <=355 budget is missed by 91 cases. I did not remove remaining distinct behavior owners to force the count.
- Current repository collection-only count is 2,347. Against the original 2,973-case baseline, this reflects the pre-existing 448-case reduction, 22 added performance regressions, and this group's net -200: `2973 - 448 + 22 - 200 = 2347`.
- Exact nodeID diff: 221 baseline nodeIDs removed, 21 current nodeIDs added or renamed by parameter reduction/test atomization; net -200. The full ledgers are below.
- No production code, fixture/conftest, test-plan, skip/xfail, collection rule, or unowned path changed.

## Retained and changed owners

- `tests/test_compact_b1_b13_regressions.py`: replaced the B-number/documentation/source-text scenario with one validator test for explicit-null `MeshMessageInput.mode`. Role-specific generated schemas are still owned by `tests/test_role_mcp_v1.py::test_role_catalogs_are_exact_and_identity_free`; compact role schema/model parity is owned by `tests/test_compact_contracts.py::test_message_conditional_requirements_and_runtime_only_rules`. B2's action/field matrix is covered by `tests/test_task_mcp_contract.py::test_schema_declares_action_specific_requirements_and_forbidden_fields` and `::test_each_task_action_accepts_minimal_and_full_request`; B10 null/empty update inputs remain in the task request/backend owners. The removed checks that searched generated prose or a source-code string asserted descriptions/implementation spelling rather than runtime behavior.
- `tests/test_compact_close_independent.py`: removed the old multi-mode/chunk reconstruction journey (the current Unicode chunk boundary owner is `tests/test_message_text_chunks.py::test_16k_unicode_reconstructs_through_role_wire_without_ack`), accepted command/recovery journey (`tests/test_read_wire_regressions.py::test_cmd_read_compacts_repeated_long_coordination_inbox_within_wire_budget` and `tests/test_compact_large_messages_independent.py::test_committed_run_retains_receipt_with_large_incoming`), refusal notice matrix (`tests/test_compact_error_notices_independent.py::test_rejected_operation_incoming_is_root_and_actionable` and `::test_legal_message_error_retains_code_and_actionable_id`), and post-commit receipt scenarios (`tests/test_task_committed_receipts_v2.py::test_mutation_success_survives_postcommit_readback_and_projection_failure`). Kept the one oversized send endpoint mapping/no-commit check because the storage rollback and injected response-preflight tests do not own that public result mapping. `test_compact_response_independent.py` helper functions remain available to its current imported helper consumers.
- `tests/test_compact_contracts.py`: removed exact generated-artifact/provenance digest and byte-metrics snapshots plus the stale annotation-anchor source-text audit. Runtime catalog/adapter owners remain `tests/test_role_mcp_v1.py::test_role_catalogs_are_exact_and_identity_free`, `tests/test_mcp_application_adapter.py::test_application_adapter_exposes_the_current_public_tools`, `tests/test_task_mcp_contract.py::test_fastmcp_runtime_arg_model_is_the_discovery_schema_source`, and `tests/test_role_output_planning.py::test_all_role_outputs_are_flat_and_budgeted`; the artifact stale-file behavior remains covered by `::test_artifact_stale_check_detects_a_modified_file` and effective app catalog mapping by `::test_builder_matches_application_actual_effective_catalogue`. Executor/coordinator duplicate message and task-list rows were reduced to the shared-model representative; role catalogs still have a separate owner.
- `tests/test_compact_incoming_budget.py`: reduced five operation/mode rows to one successful `command_run` notification budget boundary. Read projection and mode requirements are owned by `tests/test_compact_large_messages_independent.py::test_read_projection_preserves_real_message_text_and_ack_state` and `tests/test_mcp_output_contracts.py::test_message_variants`; rejected-operation alert/ACK presentation remains in `tests/test_compact_error_notices_independent.py`. The retained case checks four-message cap, remaining count, truncation notice, preview, receipt, and input immutability on the command-run output path.
- `tests/test_compact_large_messages_independent.py`: reduced same-output receipt profiles to one over-budget eight-message ASCII fixture; escaping and character/byte boundaries remain in `tests/test_read_wire_regressions.py`. Reduced persisted read projection modes to the ACK case, which proves a real stored message is projected without acknowledging/replying; message-mode formatting remains in `tests/test_mcp_output_contracts.py::test_message_variants`.
- `tests/test_compact_response_independent.py`: removed adapter journeys whose current minimal owners are `tests/test_mcp_output_contracts.py::test_cmd_variants`, `tests/test_read_contract.py` page/cursor cases, `tests/test_read_wire_regressions.py` bounded output cases, `tests/test_task_projection_core.py::test_detail_contains_only_current_state_fields`, `tests/test_task_history_cursor_stability.py` cursor/restart cases, and `tests/test_role_mcp_v1.py` role-output/health cases. Removed a self-skipping intent scenario rather than retaining a skipped case; the attached-intent path is not available on this candidate. Kept the stored checkpoint original-type test with four JSON equivalence classes (object, array, JSON-text string, empty string) because no other current owner checks this storage-to-snapshot type preservation, and kept command run's immediate/no-poll rule. Removed claim revision conflict journey maps to `tests/test_task_revision_side_effects.py::test_coordinator_classifies_stale_revision_before_noop_or_mutation` and the central public conflict formatter.
- `tests/test_compact_tmcp05_completion.py`: removed generated description phrase/source-anchor fixtures (review/build prose checks) and the compound owner/state/relation journey. Current rule owners are `tests/test_task_text_validation.py::test_stateful_text_prerequisites_are_validation_failures`, `tests/test_task_atomic_ownership_v2.py::test_safe_participant_property_update_does_not_require_exclusive_owner`, `tests/test_task_ownership_state_v2.py::test_property_update_preserves_state_and_only_explicit_state_can_change_it`, and role authorization owners. Retained explicit blank `archive_note` masking the legacy `note` fallback, and split candidate freezing into separate done-task and incoming-review triggers; these are distinct current core branches with no other direct candidate-freeze owner.
- `tests/test_documentation_contract.py`: removed runtime-version synchronization, literal retired-tool/phrase lists, exact catalog prose duplication, architecture/deployment paragraph marker checks, and a state-update check now owned by `tests/test_task_mcp_contract.py::test_state_context_has_only_minimal_workflow_fields` and `tests/test_task_ownership_state_v2.py::test_update_runtime_model_rejects_state_field`. Those were documentation/review assertions, not app or MCP behavior. Kept all runnable JSON examples and model validation, attach-only runtime validation, packaged skill/source consistency, and local link resolution. Current runtime tool roster owners are `tests/test_mcp_application_adapter.py::test_application_adapter_exposes_the_current_public_tools`, `tests/test_role_mcp_v1.py::test_role_catalogs_are_exact_and_identity_free`, and access MCP route tests.
- `tests/test_mcp_callback_html_metadata.py` and `tests/test_mcp_callback_response_metadata.py`: reduced only repeated inputs for the same classifier/log allowlist branch. Kept each observed HTML marker category, all explicitly ignored parser contexts, marker priority, malformed parser handling, HTML byte limit, JSON/HTML/other response classes, identifier value equivalence classes, explicit/default-port observations, signing bytes, and no-log-secrets cases. These current behavior/security owners have no cross-module formatter equivalent.
- `tests/test_mcp_output_contracts.py`: trimmed repeated action values that project through the same formatter branch while retaining each result group and meaningful status/action distinction. Removed its task conflict alias rows because `tests/test_public_errors.py::test_legacy_task_conflicts_map_to_registered_public_codes` owns both aliases and `::test_error_result_is_canonical_bounded_and_marked_as_error` owns generic MCP error serialization. The formatter remains this module; role output mapping remains in `tests/test_role_mcp_v1.py` and `tests/test_role_output_planning.py`.
- `tests/test_public_errors.py`: reduced repeated invalid-value representatives only where Python values exercise the same `PublicError` strict type/bound branch. Retained each kind/recovery/outcome class, domain alias behavior, repair allowlists, bounds, exception mapping, cancellation, retry guarantees, and bounded coordination notices. Public error formatting remains centralized here; task and callback domain behavior remains in its owning modules.
- `tests/test_read_contract.py` and `tests/test_read_wire_regressions.py`: kept the actual min/max page boundary and preview/escaping/clipping boundaries; dropped intermediate values using the same slice/escape branch. Exact command-read inbox behavior remains in the named wire regression owner.
- `tests/test_role_mcp_v1.py`: removed overlapping output schema/health/error journeys and static session prerequisite description assertions. Runtime input error mapping remains in `tests/test_role_wire_runtime.py`; the role catalog, authorization, hashed identity evidence, health identity diagnostics, graph nullable state, bounded activity touch, and one successful claim receipt mapping remain here. Role schema baselines remain because the endpoint is versioned.
- `tests/test_task_create_request_receipt.py`: simplified the live MCP receipt case to start/attach, create once, replay the same create, and compare receipt task IDs. The outdated `inputSchema.properties.request_id` expectation and SQL event/task counts are removed. Request ID storage, concurrency, restart, rollback, and post-commit recovery are owned by the neighboring receipt tests in this module.
- `tests/test_task_mcp_contract.py` and `tests/test_task_planning_v2.py`: removed duplicated state/value/action planning rows and trimmed planning examples to representatives while retaining the complete 11-action strict model matrix, required-field rules, distinct per-field bounds, checkpoint string/object/array JSON types, generated schema source mapping, and planning permissiveness. Removed generated-schema regression inputs duplicated by strict-model rejection and the exact generated-schema source owner, and removed the retired public `done` output variant (current discovery asserts it is absent). The checkpoint array was restored after audit because it is a distinct supported JSON type.
- `tests/test_task_projection_core.py`: reduced invalid limit values only to lower/upper bounds, boolean, and wrong type; byte-budget failures use one representative detail field and one event-history kind because the bounded projection base validator is shared. Current projection models and maximum byte count remain enforced.
- `tests/test_task_qa_public_state.py`: replaced a TestClient session/task/comment/checkpoint/schema journey with one direct `TaskStore.append_comment` duplicate rule. Append-only checkpoint behavior remains in `tests/test_task_checkpoint_append_boundary.py`; comment revision rejection remains in `tests/test_task_revision_side_effects.py`. Removed repeated invalid backend values from the same `invalid_state` branch and reduced the public invalid-state route case to one invalid literal; the executor MCP owner separately covers wrong JSON types. Kept QA migration data/index/trigger preservation, state admission, generated-ID dedupe, and concurrent update fencing.

## Composite owners reviewed and retained

These remaining compound bodies were reviewed; each covers distinct persistence, safety, or adapter behavior, so further splitting would create extra collected cases without removing an overlapping owner:

- `tests/test_task_atomic_ownership_v2.py::test_owner_swap_is_fenced_without_relying_on_task_revision`, `::test_delayed_release_cannot_release_new_claim_by_same_owner`, and side-stream post-commit receipt cases: fencing/atomicity trigger boundaries.
- `tests/test_task_revision_side_effects.py::test_revision_race_between_preflight_and_storage_is_fenced` and `tests/test_task_qa_public_state.py::test_update_cas_identical_retry_and_stale_conflicts_are_atomic`: competing revision races and different stale/conflict outcomes.
- `tests/test_task_create_request_receipt.py` storage receipt cases: agent/namespace/operation scope, concurrency, instance restart, rollback and lost-response reconciliation are separate durable guarantees.
- `tests/test_task_history_cursor_stability.py` stale/restart/stream cases: each cursor invalidation boundary is independently current.
- `tests/test_task_storage.py` schema migration cases and `tests/test_task_qa_public_state.py::test_upgrade_old_state_constraint_retains_data_indexes_and_triggers`: data-preserving schema changes remain current requirements.
- `tests/test_compact_error_notices_independent.py` and `tests/test_compact_failure_budget.py`: separate refusal, post-commit outcome, notice and serialized-budget guarantees.

No unowned test or shared helper was changed. No test depended on retired remote cross-node delivery; local messaging, recipient holds, and message-received propagation remain outside the removed scenario families.

## Runtime verification status

No asynchronous, HTTP, SQLite-body or full pytest run was launched for this worker, following the coordinator's sandbox-stall instruction. A permitted synchronous focused-helper attempt did not return a report within 30 seconds and is not counted as a pass or failure. The coordinator must verify all changed test bodies in the authorized execution environment. Collection, Ruff, compilation and diff checks are reported in `atomic-A-final.md`.
